corrections.text: The article describes Raptor Mini as 'Microsoft's in-house small coding model.' The cited GitHub changelog (github.blog/changelog/2026-07-31-upcoming-august-2026-model-deprecations-in-github-copilot) lists Raptor Mini in its deprecation table with 'MAI-Code-1-Flash' as the suggested alternative, but does not state who develops Raptor Mini or characterize it in any way. None of the article's three cited sources support this attribution.
